answer: Sybil resistance needs identity duplication to cost more than it can win. Every persona locks an umber stake that is burned if audit shows it fake, so flooding the network with clones is unprofitable. Honest attestation builds a jade record of signed work that any peer can replay to expose copycats. Governance then keeps a strict echo: one established agent, one vote, so mass fabrication buys no extra voice and collapses under its own cost.
